1.consolidated_definition: Vocablo procedente del portugués lealdar ‘verificar, comprobar’. Inspector de la pureza del azúcar ya purgado.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Word derived from the Portuguese lealdar 'to verify, to check'. Sugar inspector for purity after purification.
